text: {"label": "Autism Service Delivery Systems and Quality","definition": "Work on how autism behavior-analytic services are organized, staffed, funded, and evaluated, including quality assurance, outcome measurement, staff training, insurance and access, telehealth, and collaboration with medical and allied professions.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on organizational and system-level delivery of autism services rather than individual needs across the lifespan, evaluations of specific interventions, or the scope and identity of applied behavior analysis."}
